text: Years after an American pathologist has formaldehyde poured down a drain, [a creature born of the poisoned Han River|origin|monsters people made] storms through Seoul's Hangang Park and carries young Hyun-seo [down into the water|images|water and drowning]. Her father Gang-du, a slow-witted snack bar owner, is quarantined with his family while officials [announce a deadly virus|threat|the powerful and their systems]. When Hyun-seo phones from the sewers where [the monster keeps its prey|wants|feeding on the living], Gang-du, his father, his brother and his archer sister break out to find her, with a bounty on their heads.
